title: Canopy deployment heatmap & annotated change log (WIP)
body:
Purpose
This page is a working notebook for the Canopy feature delivery (sprint window: 2027-05-18 -> 2027-06-01). Goal: land a low-risk staged push that preserves tail-latency SLOs while enabling new routing knobs and an experimental prefix cache.

Quick context notes (notes-to-self style)
- Canopy = routing + cache + metric tagging change; touches serving async path and router.
- Risk vectors: cold KV cache misses, kernel fallbacks on quantized models, tagging blowups in logging pipeline.
- Owner/primary on-call for day-of: Priya (platform), backup: Diego.

High-level timetable (compact heatmap view)
- 2027-05-18 Tue: Feature branch merge window open (no direct prod deploys).
- 2027-05-20 Thu: Staging smoke (canary-0) — run prefix cache warmup + smoke test harness.
- 2027-05-22 Sat: Night micro-canary to 5% (region A only).
- 2027-05-24 Mon: Expand to 20% with throttles; begin telemetry sampling.
- 2027-05-26 Wed: Full-region ramp to 50% with automated rollback gates active.
- 2027-05-28 Fri: Decision meeting (go/no-go for 100%).
- 2027-05-29 Sat: Potential final ramp to 100% or staged hang at 80% for weekend.

Milestones / exit criteria (short)
- Latency: p95 < 180ms and p99 delta < +30ms vs baseline for 24h at 20% traffic.
- Errors: user-facing error rate < 0.02% and internal retry rate increase < 15%.
- Logs/Tags: tagging pipeline not exceeding 10% downstream backpressure.

Staging -> Prod Handover checklist (pre-deploy)
- [ ] Merge PRs: router, cache service, tagger, infra (PR-4387, PR-4392).
- [ ] CI green against staging image matrix (cuda/rocm) — confirm cross-kernel integration.
- [ ] Config flags added behind runtime feature flag: canopy.enabled, canopy.prefix_cache_size.
- [ ] KMS: ensure no new secrets introduced; rotate test keys if changed.
- [ ] Canary doc updated in Confluence link and signal owners pinged (#release-coord).
- [ ] Observability: dashboards for model-routing-latency, prefix-cache-hitrate, tagger-lag created and saved.
- [ ] Loadtest runbook: run 3x synthetic traces with 95th/99th capture.

Surge & throttle matrix (ops shorthand)
- Traffic window 0-5%: baseline autoscaling only. 5-20%: throttle memory-heavy requests (max-seq), enable short-cache TTL.
- 20-50%: activate conservative batching policy; reduce encoder concurrency on quantized paths.
- >50%: enable emergency quiet window; fallback route to stable model variant (redwood-stable-v1).

Canary mapping (heatmap words)
- canary-0 (staging): internal test traffic + smoke harness. Targets: staging-pool-3.
- canary-1 (5%): region-us-west-2 only, tag: canary=canopy-1. Minimal user impact.
- canary-2 (20%): us-west-2 + us-east-1, enable telemetry sampling 100x; team on-call cadence shortened to 15m.
- canary-3 (50%): multi-region, remaining safety lanes active; ops shadowing.

Smoke test checklist (scripts referenced in repo)
- [ ] base-text-gen smoke (10k tokens total across seq lengths).
- [ ] prompt-structure stress: function-calling + long context.
- [ ] KV-prefix-warm: run synthetic prefix warm script and assert hitrate > 40% after warm period.
- [ ] quantized-path validation: run model-quantize-compat suite.
- [ ] tagger throughput: synthetic tag ingestion at 2x expected to verify backpressure margin.

Annotated change-log (draft bullets for release notes)
- Routing: add per-tenant routing knobs to prefer lower-latency regions; exposes canopy.enabled flag (alpha). (PR-4387)
- Prefix cache: experimental prefix caching for repeated request families — configurable TTL and size; expected to reduce tokens served by hot prompts. (PR-4392)
- Observability: new dashboards and trace attributes (canopy.route_id, canopy.cache_hit) to help triangulate regressions.
- Fallbacks: improved model-variant fallback logic to auto-route off-peak to stable models when latency thresholds breach.

Draft release notes text (short form for release email)
- "Canopy: experimental routing + prefix caching — opt-in via canopy.enabled. Designed to lower per-token costs for repetitive prompts and improve regional latency. This initial release is alpha; enable per-tenant via the Console or API. See known issues below."

Known issues / risk log (open items)
- K1: Observed transient log spam when prefix_cache_size set > 1M in local run (Elliot investigating).
- K2: Secondary telemetry shard occasionally lags ~30s behind primary during heavy write bursts. Impact: delayed alerting for p99.
- Q: Do we need a privacy review for per-tenant routing metadata? (legal pinged)

Emergency rollback triggers (operational)
- p99 latency increase > +60ms sustained for 20m -> immediate pause and rollback to previous route config.
- User-facing error rate > 0.05% for 10m -> rollback.
- Tagging pipeline backpressure > 25% for 30m -> disable new tagger consumer and fall back.

Day-of staffing & communications (short)
- D-0 (deploy day) 07:00-13:00: Priya + Diego active; Elliot on standby for tagger issues.
- Slack channel: #canopy-launch (create before D-2). Pager rota: Priya primary -> Diego 2h -> Avery 3h night.
- Status updates cadence: 07:30 quick sync, 10:30 decision readout, 12:00 post-deploy summary.

Post-deploy checks (first 6h)
- Verify prefix-cache hitrate converges to expected for top-10 prompts.
- Confirm no increase in backend retries.
- Run partial-rollback smoke (dry-run) to confirm rollback path works.
- Collect top-10 slow traces and tag for post-mortem priority.

Open TODOs (short)
- [ ] Finalize throttle numbers for 20% -> 50% ramp.
- [ ] Add runbook snippet for secondary telemetry fallback.
- [ ] Get legal sign-off on tenant-routing metadata retention.

Notes and references
- Quick links: GH PR-4387 (router), PR-4392 (prefix cache), JIRA-RELEASE-9123 (epic).
- If we decide to pause ramping at 50%, add a mellow mode to prevent retries and reduce batch size.

End of working draft. Keep edits linear and short — treat this doc as the ops single-pane for the upcoming window.

-- a.
